fact: 在圣保罗州咖啡宣传与保价政策推动下，桑托斯咖啡价格从1927年7月的每10公斤23$700升至1928年的37$000，纽约报价从每磅16.5美分升至24美分，州内产地价从每袋60公斤8$000升至16$000。圣保罗咖啡出口量从1927年的3,478,000袋增至1928年的3,614,000袋；出口均价1927年为每袋177$000、1928年为198$000；出口总值1927年为614,214康托（合1,491.04万英镑），1928年为716,075康托（合1,757.6万英镑）。

sources.title: Wileman's Brazilian Review, 1928（圣保罗州总统年度报告分析）
sources.quote: resulting in the price of coffee, which was sold at Santos at 23$700 per 10 kilos in July, 1927, rising to 37$000 now, advancing likewise in New York from 16% per lb. to 24 cents and in the interior of the State from 8$000 per bag of 60 kilos to 16$000 per bag. ... rising from 3,279,000 bags during the first quarter of 1926, to 3,478,000 bags during the export- period in 1927 and 3,614,000 bags in 1928. The export value of coffee in 1927 averaged 177$000 per bag and in 1928 198$000 per bag, the total value of exports being 614.214 contos, equivalent to £14,910,400 in 1927, as compared with 716,075 contos and £17,576,000 in 1928.

fact: 据1928年10月的报道，巴西1927—28年度咖啡收成为该国历史最大，共29,451,684袋；由于产量过大，到1928年6月30日新季采摘开始时仍有13,109,077袋未售出，几乎相当于一年的平均出口量。银行与佣金商对农主的未售咖啡放款在1928年9月估计超过1亿美元，贷款上限为市价的三分之一至二分之一，利率10%至12%或更高；圣保罗州银行要求农主按订约时的汇率结算，以规避咖啡价格下跌带来的汇兑损失。

sources.title: The New York Times, Coffee Price Crisis Menaces Sao Paulo, 1928-10-07
sources.quote: The harvest picked in 1927, known in trading circles as the 1927-28 crop, was the largest the nation has ever produced, totaling 29,451,684 bags ... there were 13,109,077 bags still unsold on June 30, when picking began on the new crop. That quantity is nearly equal to the average exports for one year. ... the outstanding loans by banks and commission merchants totaled more than $100,000,000 ... they loan only up to a third or a half of the market price of the coffee, and charge from 10 to 12 per cent. or more. The State Bank protects itself by compelling farmers to promise to liquidate the loan at the exchange rate existing at the time the loan is contracted.

fact: 圣保罗州自1924年起实施咖啡保价（Coffee Defence），其运作依赖持续借入外债来收购与囤积咖啡。1928年中，流入巴西的外资（尤其是三级政府的债务性资金）中断，随后因稳定基金的外汇储备下降而出现货币收缩；1928年末至1930年第三季度，货币基数下降14%。

sources.title: PUC-Rio, Texto para Discussão No. 388, The Brazilian Economy, 1928-1945
sources.quote: The significant inflow of foreign capital, especially in the form of indebtedness of all three levels of government, was interrupted in the middle of the year. Monetary contraction followed as the level of foreign reserves in the Caixa de Estabilização started to fall. Between the end of 1928 and the end of the third quarter of 1930 the monetary base fell by 14%. Coffee price support, under the administration of the State of São Paulo since 1924, depended on the ability to raise foreign loans on a permanent basis, especially if, as was the case, coffee stocks tended to increase.

fact: 咖啡保价在1929年末崩塌：桑托斯咖啡价格从每磅11便士跌至7便士以下，1930至1931年继续跌至约4便士的低谷；咖啡占巴西出口总值的三分之二。巴西外汇储备1929年9月为3,100万英镑，1930年8月降至1,400万英镑，同年11月归零；联邦政府拒绝为圣保罗州的保价计划兜底，并坚持金本位。

sources.title: PUC-Rio, Texto para Discussão No. 388, The Brazilian Economy, 1928-1945
sources.quote: The lack of foreign finance and the increase in stocks resulted in the collapse of coffee prices towards the end of 1929 and thus of coffee exports which represented two thirds of total exports. ... By the end of 1929, Santos 4 coffee prices had fallen from 11 to under 7 pence per pound. The fall would continue in 1930 and 1931 to reach a trough around 4 pence. ... Foreign exchange reserves which stood at £31 million in September 1929, reached £14 million in August and had disappeared by November.

fact: 以1914年为100的里约热内卢七口之家生活费指数为：1924年261、1926年249、1927年276。1927年分项指数为食品226、燃料与照明345、衣着238、房租300、仆役300、家具与器具333、杂项188。1928年上半年必需品涨幅更大，连公共集市（Feiras Livres）也不再便宜；报道将生活费上涨部分归因于瓦加斯·路易斯稳定汇率政策把汇率定在偏低水平。

fact: 巴西一战后的房租管制由第4403号法及后续第4624号（1922）、第4793号（1924）、第4975号（1925）、第5177号（1927）等法延续；直到1928年，租赁合同的规制才回到民法典管辖，此后维持十五年。管制期间里约实际房租仍以年均4.2%上涨（1921—1927），1920至1940年间出租住房占总住房的比重大约下降三分之一。

fact: 圣保罗的银行业在1920年代后期快速扩张：本国银行从1913年的22家增至1927年的89家，外国银行从1913年的80家增至1927年的101家，银行总数1926年为182家、1927年为243家。圣保罗州总统咨文称，货币稳定前该州「几乎不存在本国银行组织」，此后才逐步按稳健基础重建。

fact: 咖啡保价把价格维持在刺激扩种的水平，而咖啡树从栽种到结果需四年，因此1928年的高价同时保证了此后数年的产量继续增加；圣保罗州与相邻各州新植面积大幅扩张，铁路沿线旧种植区（如坎皮纳斯周边）出现大量幼树，沿线广告牌已在推销化肥。报道指出，巴西的保价同时抬高了中美洲等其他产豆国的价格与产量，巴西在世界市场的份额因此下降。

sources.title: Commercial and Financial Chronicle, 1928-10-20（引《纽约时报》圣保罗通讯）
sources.quote: "Certain factors have appeared," says a special report to the New York "Times" from Sao Paulo, "which may undermine the high level of coffee prices established and controlled so successfully by the Sao Paulo Coffee Institute since its organization in September 1924." Coffee production in the State is booming, the report shows, for the Coffee Institute is keeping up prices to a level which has stimulated the planting of coffee trees on a tremendous scale. Moreover, the results will be increasingly apparent hereafter, since it takes four years for the coffee tree to come into bearing.

sources.title: The New York Times, Coffee Price Crisis Menaces Sao Paulo, 1928-10-07
sources.quote: Moreover, São Paulo's defense of coffee prices has been profitable to other producing countries, especially Central America, and production outside of Brazil will undoubtedly increase very rapidly.
